title: Capacity gates of the providers of a machine
description: The machine file <state>/orch/provider-gates.json (gates.py): a provider whose account quota is exhausted is not started again before until. Written under the lock of provider-gates.lock; keeps its published tag schema provider-gates/v1 (no $schema).

gates.description: The gate of each provider by provider id.

gate.description: One gate; an entry whose until is not a UTC time is ignored when read.

until.description: UTC time (rounded up to the second) before which the provider is not started.

class.description: Error class that set the gate (quota).

code.description: Reason code that set the gate (PROVIDER_QUOTA).

set_by.description: Conductor run that set the gate.

set_at.description: UTC time the gate was set.
